exam.title: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
exam.study_prerequisites: Expert skill in at least one security domain plus practical experience across identity and access, platform protection, security operations, data and AI security, application security, hybrid and multicloud infrastructure, architecture tradeoffs, governance, resilience, and controlled delivery.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
Design security solutions for applications and data

review.notes: Every subobjective in the July 28, 2026 blueprint is mapped to a strategy, control boundary, implementation choice, evidence artifact, failure condition, or recovery action. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original checks cover ransomware/BCDR and privileged recovery; MCRA, MCSB, Zero Trust, CAF, WAF, landing zones, secure AI and DevSecOps; XDR/SIEM/SOAR and ATT&CK; human, external, workload and agent identity; enterprise privileged access and compliance; multicloud CSPM/CWPP, Arc, EASM and Exposure Management; endpoints, OT/IoT, cloud service models and SSE; Microsoft 365/Copilot; application/API/WAF and data security. All 36 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 34 were reachable and two O'Reilly pages were access-blocked; none was missing or broken. The guide marks the 2022–2025 secondary resources as older foundations, verifies the active exam and current prerequisites, records a free Microsoft Practice Assessment and 20 hours 58 minutes of current Microsoft Learn paths, labels agent/AI/SSE/Exposure/Copilot volatility, and records no announced blueprint change or retirement.

findings.title: Prerequisite credential list changed
findings.evidence: Current official prerequisite list includes Cloud and AI Security Engineer, not the guide's older Azure Security Engineer entry.
findings.recommendation: Correct the current requirement and distinguish older course advice.
findings.resolution: Correct the current requirement and distinguish older course advice.

findings.title: All-users policies exclude agent user accounts
findings.evidence: Agent identity, OBO user and agent user are distinct policy subjects.
findings.recommendation: Add flow table and three-subject exercise, explicit targeting and preview scope.
findings.resolution: Add flow table and three-subject exercise, explicit targeting and preview scope.

findings.title: Device-less agents cannot supply endpoint signals
findings.evidence: Agent users and endpoint-specific conditions differ; agent identities currently support block controls.
findings.recommendation: Add policy-signal availability and exclusion checks.
findings.resolution: Add policy-signal availability and exclusion checks.

findings.title: Retention can exceed immutable protection
findings.evidence: Time-based protection is limited by configured duration and vault support; locked state is irreversible.
findings.recommendation: Add recovery boundary, support distinctions and RTO/RPO example.
findings.resolution: Add recovery boundary, support distinctions and RTO/RPO example.

findings.title: Recovery authorization needs independent permissions
findings.evidence: Resource Guard has operation scope, exclusions and separate role assignments.
findings.recommendation: Describe least-privilege approval and inheritance review without blanket restore-approval claims.
findings.resolution: Describe least-privilege approval and inheritance review without blanket restore-approval claims.

findings.title: Current benchmark is preview guidance
findings.evidence: MCSB v2 is preview; control mappings do not establish full compliance or automated implementation.
findings.recommendation: Add dated AI-principle and evidence guidance with service-level verification.
findings.resolution: Add dated AI-principle and evidence guidance with service-level verification.

findings.title: Portal transition changes automation and CMK boundaries
findings.evidence: Routing/correlation change, CMK coverage differs and incident updates can batch or arrive late.
findings.recommendation: Add migration acceptance tests and four-minute response example.
findings.resolution: Add migration acceptance tests and four-minute response example.

findings.title: Management API retirement differs from data-plane lifecycle
findings.evidence: Control-plane versions before 2026-02-01 retire February 27 2027; existing vaults and data-plane APIs differ.
findings.recommendation: Add inventory and dated follow-up; separate new-vault default from access migration.
findings.resolution: Add inventory and dated follow-up; separate new-vault default from access migration.

findings.title: Policy evaluation alone does not repair existing resources
findings.evidence: Existing-resource remediation requires task and authorized assignment identity; definition changes do not update identity grants automatically.
findings.recommendation: Add existing/new resource and permission validation.
findings.resolution: Add existing/new resource and permission validation.

findings.title: New subscription posture defaults and recommendation shapes change
findings.evidence: October 27 Foundational CSPM opt-in and December 14 grouped VA recommendation retirement require onboarding/report review.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped change dates, coverage example and two checkpoints.
findings.resolution: Add scoped change dates, coverage example and two checkpoints.

findings.title: Unused-action detail removed for AWS/GCP CIEM
findings.evidence: Overprovisioned identity recommendations remain but detailed unused actions no longer appear.
findings.recommendation: Require provider-native evidence before permission removal.
findings.resolution: Require provider-native evidence before permission removal.

findings.title: Forwarding alone does not enforce user Conditional Access
findings.evidence: Clientless branch forwarding differs from client-based policy and Private Access app targeting.
findings.recommendation: Add acquisition/enforcement and tenant-identity test matrix.
findings.resolution: Add acquisition/enforcement and tenant-identity test matrix.

findings.title: Copilot DLP actions cover different data paths
findings.evidence: Web search, prompt processing, source exclusions and uploads have different behavior and limits.
findings.recommendation: Add separate synthetic tests and preview/propagation caveats.
findings.resolution: Add separate synthetic tests and preview/propagation caveats.

findings.title: Mutable scan tags do not prove current content safety
findings.evidence: Results can be error/not-scanned and tags are writable; overwrites require current result validation.
findings.recommendation: Add original version-bound release example and explicit service limits.
findings.resolution: Add original version-bound release example and explicit service limits.

findings.title: IoT retirement applies to device-builder micro agent
findings.evidence: June 1 2027 planned retirement does not establish retirement of OT network sensors.
findings.recommendation: Bound the component claim and add a follow-up.
findings.resolution: Bound the component claim and add a follow-up.

blog_intake.notes: Public investigation read; credential/recovery tabletop only. Preserve uncertain initial-access attribution and unconfirmed exfiltration/ransom; ordinary compromised service principals are not automatically Agent ID objects.

offline_checks: Thirteen synthetic arithmetic/set checks for recovery, response timing, coverage, scan dispositions/version, agent subjects and course/module sums

limitations: Accepted July 28 baseline retained; all 81 October 21 objectives mapped separately. Current credential prerequisite supersedes older guide/course wording.
No Azure/Microsoft 365 tenant, agent, recovery, malware scan, network, policy, incident-response or destructive action executed. Ten labs remain learner exercises/tabletops.
Agent-user/risk controls, ISOC, some Copilot DLP capabilities and MCSB v2 have preview/version boundaries; tenant-level availability and enforcement unverified.
MCSB AI article labels its content last reviewed December 1, 2025 and recommended guidance; not a certification standard or automatic enforcement guarantee.

Learn landing pages list 19 modules; current module durations not independently verified. Paid courses and signed-in assessment not reviewed. Two O'Reilly URLs/Udemy blocked, YouTube shell; earlier metadata explicitly historical.
Lab README and first readiness-video chapter list reviewed, not individual labs or videos. Partner PDF response did not yield reliable current event metadata.

Blog articles reviewed; linked videos, gated intelligence, deployments and customer outcomes not tested. Threat report does not confirm exposed credential as initial access, ransom demand or successful exfiltration.
Same-context AI research/repair; independent and human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
